component.name: Disk Utility
component.summary: Erase, partition and repair disks, and work with disk images

description.p: Disk Utility shows the internal and external disks, their partitions and volumes, and the disk images that are open, with their capacity, format, connection and S.M.A.R.T. health.

It mounts, unmounts and ejects volumes, erases disks as ext4, encrypted ext4, ExFAT, FAT32 or NTFS with a GUID or MBR partition map, adds, deletes and resizes partitions, checks and repairs volumes with First Aid, creates and restores disk images, and writes an image to a USB drive. Every change asks for authorization; the startup disk and a Mac's own partitions stay read-only.
